description: This file defines a Qwik component for a recipe detail page, including data loading logic, rendering functions, styles, and metadata. It handles fetching a recipe by ID, rendering recipe details, ingredients, steps, nutrition, and error/loading states.

methods.name: useRecipe
methods.description: A route loader that fetches a recipe's detailed data by ID, supporting SSR and CSR, with caching and error handling.

methods.name: timeBadge
methods.description: Renders a badge showing the time value if provided.

methods.name: renderIngredient
methods.description: Renders a single ingredient list item, handling string or object formats.
